about: The Workbench icons of the EDuke32 drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is EDuke32's own program icon (source/duke3d/rsrc/game_icon.ico, its 256-pixel picture at 64 x 64). EDuke32-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, EDuke32.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's EDuke32.info. GameData.info is the icon of the drawer for the user's DUKE3D.GRP. The tool types in brackets are off; take the brackets away to use one (each tool type starting with '-' is a command-line switch).
